title: A New Transformer-Based Approach for Audio-Based Kinship Verification and a New Uncontrolled Mandarin Kinship Speech Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2609.14145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kinship verification is a task involving determining whether two individuals share a first-order kin relation. To tackle this task, we propose CONVTRAP-TN, a new architecture for audio-based kinship verification, and conduct an ablation study on the proposed model. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to apply the successful transformer architecture to the task of audio-based kinship verification. Furthermore, we also collect a custom speech dataset, ARKIN, which accurately reflects everyday recording conditions. We do this because only a few speech datasets with kinship labels currently exist, all of which either source extremely noisy in-the-wild data from the internet, or instruct speakers to record in specific environments. These settings fail to reflect real-world scenarios where users record on personal devices under unrestrained conditions. translated_title: 一种新的基于Transformer的音频亲属关系验证方法及一个新的非受控普通话亲属关系语音数据集
translated_abstract: 亲属关系验证是一项确定两个人之间是否具有一级亲属关系的任务。为了解决这一任务，我们提出了CONVTRAP-TN，这是一种新的基于音频的亲属关系验证架构，并对所提出的模型进行了消融研究。据我们所知，我们是首个将成功的Transformer架构应用于基于音频的亲属关系验证任务的研究。此外，我们还收集了一个自定义语音数据集ARKIN，它准确反映了日常录音条件。我们这样做是因为目前仅有少数带有亲属关系标签的语音数据集，它们要么从互联网上获取极其嘈杂的野外数据，要么指示说话者在特定环境中录音。这些设置未能反映用户在个人设备上无限制条件下录音的真实场景。此外，我们还进行了一系列初步的基线实验
tldr: 本文提出了首个将Transformer架构应用于音频亲属关系验证的新模型CONVTRAP-TN，并发布了准确反映日常真实录音条件的普通话亲属关系语音数据集ARKIN。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CONVTRAP-TN, the first Transformer-based architecture for audio-based kinship verification, and introduces ARKIN, a new Mandarin kinship speech dataset that accurately reflects real-world uncontrolled recording conditions.
